result.official_quote: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property. For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, it shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
result.note: The citation now pinpoints § 98.1103(b), the landlord-use ban; it lists the sale ban in (a), the "two or more landlords" definition in § 98.1102 and the remedies in § 98.1104(a) as see-also cites, and puts the ordinance in house form; the quote now comes from the adopted code text (D074), because the card's own quote stays from the supplied corpus D076, which is only the unadopted draft O-2025-107, whose definition and fee terms differ from the adopted law.
